summary.text: Alexander Cooke is a former Juno Beach mayor and councilmember running without party affiliation for Florida's 21st District. He describes himself as a fiscal conservative with more than 20 years in investment management and trading, and he campaigns on water quality, development, and housing and insurance costs.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Cooke graduated from Curtis Senior High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Fairfield University in 2005.

He says his first job, as a teenager, was as an assistant to a maintenance worker at a low-income housing property in Washington state, and that he lived in a car during his teenage years amid family difficulties.
He has worked as a financial executive, says he has more than 20 years of experience in investment management and trading, and owns and runs Optimist Capital LLC in Palm Beach Gardens.
According to his survey responses, Cooke served as Mayor and Councilmember of Juno Beach from 2022 to 2024.
He says he has a record of fighting overdevelopment and for the environment, and that he opposes spending taxpayer money on what he calls vanity projects.
